title: A Warning With a Crest
body: A rival house sent a note that is not a note. It is a season. The docks already know. Heat is a smell. You can answer, pay, or pretend the rain is louder.

choices.text: Stand on the dock. Let them see you.

outcomes.title: A public spine
outcomes.body: You do not flinch. The house files you as expensive. Heat climbs because you were visible.
outcomes.log: Answered a war-season warning in person.

outcomes.title: They counted your windows
outcomes.body: Standing made you a target. A brick found a pane that had your name on the lease.
outcomes.log: A war warning found a window.

choices.text: Pay a quiet tribute. Buy a week.

outcomes.title: A purchased pause
outcomes.body: Cash walks. The warning stays. You bought weather, not peace.
outcomes.log: Paid tribute in a war threat year.

outcomes.title: They took the envelope and the week
outcomes.body: Tribute bought you an hour. The season still opened.
outcomes.log: Tribute in a war year came up short.

choices.text: Stay inside. Let the year blink.

outcomes.title: A quieter door
outcomes.body: The house thinks you blinked. Stress drops. The street does not forget.

title: The War Takes a Street
body: This is the hot year. A crew you do not pay is standing where your name used to stand. You can spend blood, cash, or the last of your calm.

outcomes.title: A street that flinches
outcomes.body: You make a noise the city will invoice. The house steps off one corner.
outcomes.log: Pressed back in a hot war year.

outcomes.title: A bad press
outcomes.body: They brought more hands. You keep the story and lose the easy night.

outcomes.title: Cash for weather
outcomes.body: Money is a kind of army. The street returns looking embarrassed.
outcomes.log: Bought a street back in war season.

outcomes.title: They kept a corner anyway
outcomes.body: You paid. They smiled. One alley still isn't yours.
outcomes.log: Bought weather in war and still lost a corner.

choices.text: Yield the night. Keep the body.

outcomes.title: A lost corner
outcomes.body: You live. The map changes. Heirs will ask about this year later.
outcomes.log: Yielded a night in a hot war.

title: A Table That Wants an Ending
body: The war is breaking. Someone sent coffee like it is a treaty. You can close the season clean, or leave a tooth in it for later.

choices.text: Take the truce. Cool the house.

outcomes.title: A closed season
outcomes.body: You drink the coffee. Hostility thins. The rain sounds like an invoice you already paid.

outcomes.title: Coffee with a tooth in it
outcomes.body: They smiled. The season closed. Someone still owes someone a street.
outcomes.log: A war truce came with a leftover invoice.

outcomes.title: An unfinished war
outcomes.body: They will come back. You will be ready, or you will be a story. The name stays sharp.
outcomes.log: Left a tooth in a war truce.

outcomes.title: They bit first
outcomes.body: Leaving a tooth meant they left two. Heat stays. The coffee goes cold.
